label: preparing
what: Innkeeper, freight and builder are jointly preparing refreshments and an evening gathering in the town hall great hall at 18:00. The mayor approved a civic-hospitality appointment but has not been given its detailed agenda. An original 120-loaf order and builder's separately paid 80 additional loaves indicate substantial preparations; builder and innkeeper have carried bread. Baker supplies the bread, and secretary knowingly arranges the appointment and escort and investigates payment. Reports mention bridge or port changes, but their substance and connection to the gathering remain unconfirmed. Neighbour knows of the gathering, but active involvement is not established.
